title: Annie Besant & Theosophical Society
definition: The Theosophical Society was an international organization founded in 1875 to promote the study of comparative religion, philosophy, and science, with Annie Besant serving as its President (1907–1933) and transforming it into a vehicle for Indian cultural revival and political nationalism.
importanceInUpsc: Essential for understanding the 'Cultural-Nationalist' phase of the Indian Freedom Struggle, the synthesis of Western occultism with Eastern philosophy, and the evolution of the Home Rule Movement.
learningOutcomes: Master foundational concepts and mechanisms of Annie BesantTheosophical Society.
Evaluate spatial distribution, institutional frameworks, and policy dimensions.
Apply high-yield mnemonics to solve tricky Prelims and Mains questions.
prerequisites: Socio-Religious Reform Movements of the 19th Century
